transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I’m just… really tired. Like, I can barely make it through my shifts lately. Rest doesn’t seem to help much. My body feels heavy, kind of like it’s filled with wet sand.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
I don’t know… maybe a little. I’ve just been worn out more than anything.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you normally like to do?
Yeah… I guess. Stuff I usually like—cooking, playing guitar, going hiking, even going to my family’s—just kind of feels… flat. Like I’m doing it because I’m supposed to, not because I really care.
Have you been feeling sad most of the time?
I’m not sure I’d say sad most of the time. It’s more like… drained, I guess. Kind of numb.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in?
Not really. Even the stuff I usually like—cooking, playing guitar, hiking, seeing my family—it all just feels kind of flat. Like I’m going through the motions.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um… maybe about four months now. The low, empty feeling kind of stuck around after that first burst of energy at work faded.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?
Yeah… a little, I think. My appetite’s been kind of up and down, but lately I just forget to eat, or food doesn’t really taste like anything. My work pants feel looser.
Have you ever felt this way before, with periods of feeling drained or numb like you do now?

Yeah… I mean, I’ve been tired before, but not like this. That’s kind of why I came in. I’m so tired I can barely get through a shift. It feels like my body’s full of wet sand, and sleeping or resting doesn’t really fix it.
How long have you been feeling drained and numb, exactly?
About four months… maybe a little more. Since after that high-energy stretch at work wore off, I’ve just felt kind of empty and worn down.
Have you ever felt this way before?

Not really like this, no. I mean, I’ve been tired before, but this is… it’s why I came in. I can barely get through a shift, and even if I rest, I don’t really feel back to myself. It’s like my body’s just heavy.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt significantly better than you do now, with more energy and interest in activities?

Yeah… there was a stretch where I felt a lot better. Like, almost too good, I guess. I had way more energy and was more cheerful, but I’d also get irritated really fast over little things, like if someone asked me to count a drawer again.
Have you ever had an episode like this before in your life?

Yeah… I guess I’ve had something like that before. For a while I felt almost unstoppable, really cheerful, but I’d also snap over little stuff. Like someone asking me to count the drawer again would set me off.
How many times have you had an episode like the one where you felt almost unstoppable and cheerful?
Maybe… a couple times. Not a lot. It’s hard to count exactly, but I remember more than once feeling that almost unstoppable, extra cheerful way, and then getting set off over small things.
How long did those episodes where you felt almost unstoppable and cheerful usually last?
Usually… about a month, I think. This last one’s been going on since the store changed our hours for the remodel.
Did you ever feel almost unstoppable and cheerful for more than a couple of weeks at a time?
Yeah… more than a couple weeks. This time it’s been about a month, since they changed the store hours for the remodel.
Has your current period of feeling drained and numb lasted for more than 2 months?
Yeah… more than two months. It’s been around four months, I think. The low, empty feeling just kind of stayed after that first burst of energy at work faded.
Have you had more than one episode of feeling drained and numb like you do now in the past?
I… I’m not really sure. I don’t think I kept track of it like that. This one’s the one I notice most.
Do you think your episodes of feeling drained and numb happen at the same time every year or in a regular pattern?
I don’t know… I haven’t really noticed a yearly pattern or anything. It just kind of happens, I guess.
Have you had episodes of feeling drained and numb like this before?
I don’t really know. Maybe, but… I didn’t think of it that way before. I can’t say for sure.
Do you think your current episode of feeling drained and numb might be related to a previous one, or is it something that seems completely separate?
I’m not sure. It doesn’t really feel connected to anything specific… but I also haven’t thought about it that way much.
